guitar.evidence: Marty Friedman, famed for his Megadeth-era lead work (e.g. "Tornado of Souls"), played Jackson guitars in Megadeth and later had Ibanez/ESP signature models; well documented in metal guitar circles.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown; Friedman is a guitar virtuoso with well-documented gear history.

tone.target: fast singing lead with bright sustain and dry 80s metal bite
tone.profile: fast singing lead with bright sustain and dry 80s metal bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain featuring a Tube Screamer boost into a British Marshall-style amp (UK 45/50) with a clear 4x12 cabinet, enhanced by subtle delay and compression for singing sustain.
